_doc: Bloom nests in the forest-encounter scatter (ADR-0054 / ADR-0055): kind 'nest' sites are built by BloomNests (Encounters.register_kind), and each encounter id names the nest def it builds (data/nests). Rare, deep in the woods and where the Bloom is thickest (burnt forest, fen). No clearing of their own: the nest's mat clears the vegetation (VegetationManager.set_clearings).
